verdict.rationale: Every core document-processing capability shown in the UI/Playground (convert, structured extraction, segmentation, form filling, track changes, pipelines) is also documented as an API endpoint or SDK/CLI feature, and runtime probes confirm the SDK/CLI and API are live and functional, with docs framing the UI (Forge/Playground) as merely a no-code preview of the same API-backed engine. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement guaranteeing full UI/API parity, and coverage of account/billing/dashboard-only actions (e.g., 2FA setup, webhook management) being confirmed as API-accessible.
